# CuizIN

> CuizIN is India's free points-based quiz platform. Players answer trivia across categories, earn points, and climb monthly leaderboards.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Play the daily quiz and see top players.
- [Play Quiz](/quiz): Start a quiz session across categories and difficulties.
- [Browse Questions](/browse): Explore the full question bank.
- [Categories](/categories): All quiz categories (Science, History, Sports, etc.).
- [Topics](/topics): Curated topic pages with related questions.
- [Web Stories](/stories): Mobile-friendly swipeable quiz stories.
- [Blog](/blog): Articles, tips, and guides about quizzes and learning.
- [FAQ](/faq): Common questions about CuizIN.
- [How to Play](/how-to-play): Rules, scoring, and tips.
- [Referral Program](/referral-program): Invite friends and earn bonus points.
- [Login](/login): Sign in to your account.
- [Register](/register): Create a new account.

## Optional

- [Terms](/terms): Terms of service.
- [Privacy](/privacy): Privacy policy.
- [Disclaimer](/disclaimer): Site disclaimer.
